cautions: prices contains 27 canonical mappings for audit; manufacturerObservations contains the 24 unique exact manufacturer observations with referenceAliases additive mappings for integration.
All ready prices are official current US manufacturer USD list benchmarks. No FX conversion or dealer market asks.
JLC explicitly excludes tax. Other manufacturers' selected-price tax treatment is unconfirmed; do not infer tax treatment from region alone.
Alias equivalence is exact full-SKU identity backed by the existing manifest, not similarity of model names or appearance.
Blancpain 5015-1130-52A price applies to selected sail-canvas/pin-buckle configuration; folding-clasp variants may differ.
Bell & Ross BR0392-BL-CE is the exact 42 mm $4,000 page; unavailable status is retained, and the newer 41 mm recommended model is excluded.
Observation date is not manufacturer effective date; all effectiveDate values remain null. Prices do not promise stock.
